correctness.rationale: The nine AG(2,3) points and twelve affine lines give X={no full line} and Theta={some line disjoint}; Theta is exactly X Alexander dual with respect to the nine vertices. Independent enumeration of all 512 vertex masks gave 172 X faces (including empty) and 340 Theta faces. Reconstructed vertex-toggle discrete-Morse matchings contain 79 and 163 nonempty pairs and complete acyclic Hasse orientations of 504 and 1260 edges, leaving critical cells (0:1,2:1,3:11) and (0:1,3:11,4:1). The inspected verify.py further eliminates all matched pairs by unit integral Schur complements and checks the only possible 3-to-2 and 4-to-3 Morse boundaries vanish; Hurewicz for the simply connected lower skeleton makes the attaching maps null. Thus the two stated integral homotopy sphere-wedges are mathematically supported. Crucially, this is a verification of an already published theorem, not independent proof of novelty.
